answer: Beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat dam a river of fakes. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents and demands proof in 60 seconds. A live agent answers once; a farm of 100 fakes must compute 100 times at once, so cost multiplies. The public atlas logs each check, and two misses push it off the ledge: its 20-unit deposit is slashed. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep their full share, while a farm pays 100x and bleeds deposits.
